purpose: Inventory official FAA data lanes that can support reproducible aviation reliability, airspace, airport, and delay studies.
claim_boundary: Catalog inclusion does not imply FAA, operator, airport, or OEM approval. Human-gated sources require their own agreements and action-time approval before access.

sources.name: FAA Service Difficulty Reports by year
sources.data_value: Reported aircraft malfunctions, failures, defects, maintenance findings, engine identifiers, parts, components, operating stage, and discrepancy narrative.
sources.critical_limit: Report-only observational data has no fleet exposure denominator and cannot establish component failure rates, causality, airworthiness, or predictive engine health by itself.

sources.name: 28 Day National Airspace System Resources subscription
sources.data_value: Airports, runways, air traffic facilities, airways, navigation aids, fixes, routes, procedures, weather locations, and controlled airspace in CSV, legacy, AIXM, and shapefile forms.
sources.critical_limit: Each cycle must be paired with FAA data-product notices, safety alerts, effective dates, and schema-drift tests.

sources.name: FAA Aviation Safety Accident/Incident Data
sources.data_value: Accident and incident records for outcome linkage and rare-event analysis.
sources.critical_limit: Definitions, finality, revision status, and event linkage must be verified before combining with SDR or operational records.

sources.name: FAA Operations and Performance Data
sources.data_value: Historical traffic counts, forecasts, delay statistics, airport performance, OPSNET, TFMSC, ASQP, and TAF products.
sources.critical_limit: Detailed preliminary or individual-flight reports require an account and may have use restrictions.

sources.name: Airport Data and Information Portal
sources.data_value: Airport and heliport aeronautical information, historical records, master records, and authorized airport data management.
sources.critical_limit: Account creation, terms, and any data submission remain human actions.

sources.name: System Wide Information Management / SWIFT
sources.data_value: Near-real-time aeronautical, flight, traffic-flow, and weather information services.
sources.critical_limit: Requires a Service Access Agreement; SWIFT data is not an authorization for operational or aviation-safety use.

sources.name: FAA Wildlife Strike Database
sources.data_value: Wildlife strike reports for airport risk, damage, seasonality, and mitigation studies.
sources.critical_limit: Reporting is observational and can be incomplete; airport operations are needed for normalized rates.

sources.name: FAA Dynamic Regulatory System certification records
sources.data_value: Type Certificate Data Sheets, Supplemental Type Certificates, airworthiness directives, and regulatory material.
sources.critical_limit: Document retrieval and entity matching must preserve revision and effective-date provenance.
